modes.label: Numbers in tables and codes
modes.description: A digit or space partway through a long run of numbers, such as data rows, DOIs or hex IDs.

modes.label: Search prompts
modes.description: The word "for" right after "Search" in website text.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or space between items in a numbered list or a reference marker.

card.plain: It fires on digits and spacing inside strings of numbers, like table rows and codes, and on "for" after "Search".
